title: Infinitude of rational points on an elliptic curve
exact_target: Determine, for an arbitrary rational elliptic curve, whether it has infinitely many rational points.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8900012 (AMR-088-0012). CC BY 4.0.
Christian Wuthrich, \emph{Open problems in number theory}, lecture slides (December 2011) slides headed An elliptic curve and Question, with examples $y^2=x^3+x+1$ and $y^2=x^3+x+2$.
